content.title: UFL schedule Week 2: What games are on today? TV channel, live stream
content.text: April 3, 2026, 6:31 a.m. ETThe UFL is continuing to experiment in the spring football space in its third season. The league's latest trial? Week 2 will end with a Tuesday night clash between the St. Louis Battlehawks and Dallas Renegades.The Tuesday night football game won't be a staple of the UFL's 2026 schedule. In fact, it's the only game scheduled for a Tuesday during the league's third unified season since the XFL-USFL merger.Still, it's a sign that new UFL investor Mike Repole is willing to test a myriad of factors as he hones the spring football league's strategic vision and seeks to establish it as a long-term fixture.Week 1 of the 2026 UFL season featured some tight games, as three of the four contests were decided by one score. The lone blowout came in the Dallas Renegades' 36-17 win over the Houston Gamblers, during which Renegades quarterback Austin Reed established himself as a spring-league star in the making.Week 2 will feature the home debut of the Columbus Aviators, one of the UFL's three relocated franchises, while the Louisville Kings will look to earn their first-ever win against the Orlando Storm.Here's a look at the UFL's Week 2 schedule for 2026 and how to watch all four matchups.UFL schedule Week 2: What games are on today?The second week of the UFL season will feature one game on Friday, one Saturday, one Sunday and one on Tuesday. Below are the full details of the league's Week 2 schedule.(All times Eastern.)Friday, April 3DC Defenders at Columbus Aviators, 8 p.m., FoxSaturday, April 4Louisville Kings at Orlando Storm, 8 p.m., ESPNSunday, April 5Birmingham Stallions at Houston Gamblers, 6 p.m., NFL NetworkTuesday, April 7St. Louis Battlehawks at Dallas Renegades, 8 p.m., FoxFriday UFL game time, TV channel, live streamDC Defenders at Columbus AviatorsStart time: 8 p.m. ETTV channel: FoxLive stream: FuboThe Aviators (0-1) are set to play their inaugural home game as a UFL franchise. Ted Ginn Jr.'s squad will search for its first-ever win at Historic Crew Stadium while facing the DC Defenders (0-1).Columbus is fresh off a 23-16 loss to the Orlando Storm, during which quarterback Jalan McClendon performed efficiently, but the team managed to break into the end zone just once.Meanwhile, the reigning UFL champion Defenders will be looking to jumpstart an offense that scored just 10 points in a Week 1 loss to the Battlehawks. Coach Shannon Harris will be looking to get better play out of his offensive line, which allowed Jordan Ta'amu to be sacked seven times in their 16-10 loss.Saturday UFL game time, TV channels, live streamsLouisville Kings at Orlando StormStart time: 8 p.m. ETTV channel: ESPNLive stream: Fubo | ESPN Unlimited/ESPN SelectThe Storm (1-0) won their home opener against the Aviators. They will once again play at Inter&Co Stadium while looking to knock off a second consecutive expansion team, the Kings (0-1).Orlando's offense was well-balanced against Columbus. Quarterback Jack Plummer starred, completing 17 of 22 passes for 240 yards and a touchdown, while running back Jashaun Corbin racked up 66 yards and two touchdowns on the ground.The Kings nearly managed to beat the three-time spring-league champion Stallions in their Week 1 home opener, but a couple of Jason Bean interceptions hurt their chances of doing so. Chris Redman will need his quarterback to play a bit cleaner in order to beat the experienced Anthony Becht's squad on the road.Sunday UFL game time, TV channel, live streamBirmingham Stallions at Houston GamblersStart time: 6 p.m. ETTV channel: NFL NetworkLive stream: FuboThe Stallions (1-0) won their first-ever game without Skip Holtz. Matt Corral led Birmingham on a game-winning drive against Louisville, hitting Justyn Ross for a 14-yard touchdown to help give first-time coach A.J. McCarron a victory.The Gamblers (0-1) were blown out 36-17 at the hands of the Renegades but still got a solid performance from quarterback Hunter Dekkers. Kevin Sumlin's team will look to hold up better defensively against Corral and Co. and will also try to establish a running game, something it couldn't do against Dallas, at Shell Energy Stadium.Tuesday UFL game time, TV channel, live streamSt. Louis Battlehawks at Dallas RenegadesStart time: 8 p.m. ETTV channel: FoxLive stream: FuboThe UFL's Tuesday night game figures to be the matchup of the week, as the Renegades vs. Battlehawks at Toyota Stadium is the lone battle of unbeatens in Week 2.Tuesday's game should be a strength-on-strength matchup, as the Battlehawks allowed a league-low 10 points in Week 1 while the Renegades scored a league-high 36. Battlehawks have one of the league's best pass rushes while the Renegades sport a top-tier passing game.Austin Reed will be the top player to watch, as he completed 26 of 40 passes for 376 yards and three touchdowns in Dallas' 36-17 win over Houston. St. Louis' pass rush, which had seven sacks in Week 1, will do its best to rattle the former Western Kentucky and Chicago Bears quarterback.
